exam_versions.note: PATCH of v1.1 (exam membership identical — same 34 tasks; only one task's verifier changed, hence 1.1.1 not 1.2). Made one task's gold-test-injection idempotent (it appended a test module without a guard, so the harness's pre-fix + post-fix passes appended it twice → duplicate-definition compile error → the task was unpassable-by-construction: 1 pass in 158 fleet attempts, and the model wrote the correct fix every time). Verified the repaired verifier still fails on the unfixed base and passes on the fixed reference, twice. Exam membership unchanged (34 tasks); only that task's verification changed, so scores for it under 34t-4885e69a and earlier are NOT comparable to v1.2. All other tasks' versions are unchanged and remain comparable across v1.1↔v1.2. Companion harness bump run-swe-personal.py@7 (plan 059) fixed three grading-correctness bugs (committed-solution false no-op, seeded self-check mis-flagged as leakage, pure-append test mis-flagged as tampering); those are @N-level and do not change task_version, and historical records are corrected offline by scripts/eval/regrade-records.py without re-running.
